//: Markdown only. oxfmt also claims YAML/JSON/CSS/TS/HTML, and pointing it at this repo root unscoped would rewrite .github/workflows and the Go-templated YAML in deploy/charts. The ignorePatterns deny-list makes that impossible by construction, so the config is safe even when invoked without a path. events-frontend/.oxfmtrc.json shadows this file entirely for anything under events-frontend/ (nested configs replace, they do not merge), which is why the format script passes --disable-nested-config.
